title: Interaction between learning, information and organization

protocol.calibration_B1: each of 9 pairs once in lexicographic order
protocol.calibration_B2: three matching cycle repeated three times
protocol.partial_feedback_stream: random.Random(seed XOR 0xB2F33D), one rank in 0,1,2 per period
protocol.tiebreak: lexicographically smallest maximum-score matching; solver value verified by six-permutation enumeration
protocol.B2_oracle: maximum true-mean full matching each period
protocol.trace_encoding: period index implicit; action ids and observed/success edge masks; compressed JSONL sidecar

policy_definitions.B1: select one of nine agent-task pairs; observe only its Bernoulli reward
policy_definitions.B2-Semi: execute a complete matching; observe each of the three individual Bernoulli rewards
policy_definitions.B2-Partial: execute same complete matching; observe one executed edge, selected by pre-generated rank
policy_definitions.UCB1: existing PairwiseBanditEstimator; mean over full pair history plus sqrt(2 log(max(2,t+1))/n)
policy_definitions.SW-UCB: existing PairwiseBanditEstimator; global-period window and xi=2 confidence bonus
policy_definitions.adaptation_note: Per-edge indices composed with multi-play choice/matching are HLS experimental adaptations; no single-play regret guarantee is asserted.

limitations: B1 E1 has nine candidate pairs and is not an exact reproduction of the prior three-arm B1 result.
B1 and B2 use different action sets and reward scales; absolute regret is not compared across modalities.
B2-Semi versus B2-Partial is a closed-loop feedback-protocol contrast; histories and later actions diverge.
SW-UCB xi=2 is the predeclared E1 common confidence scale, not a claim that the compositional B2 method inherits original single-play guarantees.
The scenario is synthetic and does not represent empirically calibrated cycle durations.
